free_tier_limits: Business-email signups receive a 30-day trial. Ongoing free API keys are grants limited to verified public-interest journalism, civil-society advocacy, qualifying academic research, and specified public institutions.
rate_limits: Keys have account-specific monthly quotas shown in the API console. Exceeding quota returns HTTP 429 until the next calendar month; support can change it. Contact OpenSanctions before exceeding 200,000 requests/hour or 2 million queries/month.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: ORIGINAL is incorrect; the official API page confirms a 30-day trial, while the exemption page restricts ongoing free API keys to verified public-interest work. Sources: https://www.opensanctions.org/api/ and https://www.opensanctions.org/docs/commercial/exemption/. rate_limits: ORIGINAL is incorrect; monthly quotas, HTTP 429 behavior, console visibility, support changes, and high-volume contact thresholds are published at https://www.opensanctions.org/docs/api/faq/#quota.
